segments.text: Listen up. Slow heart, good sleep. Fast heart, bad sleep. Food? Don't.
4 hours before bed, last meal. Eat, make belly work. Busy belly, fast heart. Fast heart, bad sleep. Phone? No. 1 hour before bed.
Walk, breathe, read? Yes. Bedtime, same every night. Good. Body likes when things same. Sun go down, light go red. Blue light, bad.
Room dark, room cold, room quiet? Yes. Wake up outside, 15 minutes, light in eyes? Good. Sun tells body when day and when night. Do this, sleep well, live long time.
